propositions: Every new plan review must sign cryptographic pins recording the current narrow material fingerprint and canonical ID of each direct child and direct prerequisite at the moment of review
When enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, material drift in a pinned related ticket invalidates the downstream attestation naturally by detecting fingerprint differences at validity check time
Plan review phase transitions only on winning process_status events targeting open or in_progress; pre-feature snapshots bootstrap planning for open/idea status and execution for all other statuses
Execution-phase reviews carry a fixed 0.80 priority-floor that becomes a blocking threshold for normal criteria, while prerequisite-consistency retains 0.60
When require_plan_review_for_close is enabled, task/story/epic close operations must have a current certified plan review compatible with the ticket's execution phase

Unreadable or unresolvable pinned targets stop review before LLM evaluation; any prerequisite evaluation failure that cannot complete attribution returns unsigned INDETERMINATE, preventing certification
